# Release Notes: March 17, 2026

The Network360 Team is excited to share the latest updates designed to enhance your experience.



## New Features

### Added Compare Networks for Broker Clients 

Enabled broker clients to use Compare Networks. Brokers can now access Compare Networks views and summary-level exports (PDF/CSV).



### Rows-per-Page Control for Analysis and Matching Configuration 

* Introduced a **Rows per Page** selector across all paginated tables in the Analysis section, including:

   * Analysis landing page

   * Summary Overview

   * Providers

   * Manual Match tabs

* Extended the **Rows per Page** selector to the Matching Configuration section, including:

   * Matching Configuration landing page

   * All post-selection pages: High, Medium, and Low Confidence

* Enabled users to choose how many rows to display per page: 5, 10, 20, 25, 50, 100

* Added next/previous pagination controls to navigate between pages.

* Ensured the table controls are accessible and keyboard-friendly, making it easier to review and manage large datasets

## Enhancements

### Improved Deletion Messages for Analyses and Related Files

Enhanced the alert messages shown after deleting analyses, matching configurations, utilization files, and processing files. The message now clearly indicates whether single or bulk delete actions were fully successful, partially successful, or fully failed, and displays the relevant item/file names for successful deletions and error messages for failed ones. 

### Improved Activation / Deletion Messages for Bulk User Deletion

We’ve improved the bulk activate/deactivate experience in Manage Users to make it clearer and more responsive:

* **Immediate feedback:** Added Action Initiated alert notifications right after clicking Deactivate or Activate, so admins know the process has started.

* **Clear status messages:**

   * **Activation:** “Activation Initiated! You will be notified in the application when the activation is complete.”

   * **Deactivation:** “Deactivation Initiated! You will be notified in the application when the deactivation is complete.”

* **Consistent completion summary:** A green alert message appears when processing finishes, summarizing how many accounts were deactivated and updating the active and inactive user lists accordingly.

### Updated Terminology: **Volatility** to **Provider Turnover** in Compare Networks 

Updated the Compare Networks terminology **Volatility** to **Provider Turnover**. This update has been made across graphs, legends, and geography views for both single and multi-network comparisons, improving clarity without changing any underlying metric calculations.


## Fixes

### Disabled Utilization File Links for Unshared Analyses

Utilization file links for unshared analyses are now restricted for non-CA users across the Disruption module. When Utilization File is not shared, non-CA users will see the Utilization File hyperlink disabled on:

* The Summary Overview page (above the graph and table)

* The Show Analysis Criteria section of the Summary Overview page

* The All Analyses page

This prevents non-CA users from accessing or acting on unshared Utilization Files while still allowing them to view the analysis itself.

### Fixed Incorrect Sorting for Last Refreshed in Data Vintage

Sorting is now fully chronological (year + month) in both Your Networks and Competitors Networks tabs and works correctly in ascending and descending order reflecting the underlying dates.

### Improved Readability of Overlap Counts in the Compare Networks Graph

Updated label positioning and refined bar/overlap colors (including white text with a black outline) in UI to ensure all overlap values are clearly readable against the background.
